phoneCalls.title: Phone calls
phoneCalls.intro: Your bot can phone businesses for you, like booking a table. It uses your own voice account and number, so calls show on your own bill.
phoneCalls.desktopOnly: Phone calls need the Murage desktop app.
phoneCalls.askBot: Ask your bot to walk you through it
phoneCalls.askBotPrompt: Help me set up phone calls.
phoneCalls.step.account: Make a Vapi account and add a card.
phoneCalls.step.number: Get a number that can call out.
phoneCalls.step.numberHow: Vapi's no-cost numbers only take incoming calls. Buy a number at Twilio or another carrier, then import it in Vapi.
phoneCalls.key.label: Vapi private key
phoneCalls.key.storeUnavailable: Murage could not keep the key on this computer.
phoneCalls.key.bad: That does not look like a Vapi private key.
phoneCalls.key.removeFailed: Murage could not change the key on this computer.
phoneCalls.numbers.pick: Pick the number your bot calls from. Murage only reads your numbers and never dials during setup.
phoneCalls.numbers.none: No numbers found in your Vapi account yet.
phoneCalls.form.title: Caller settings
phoneCalls.form.aiLaw: In some places, such as the EU, the law expects AI callers to say they are an AI.
phoneCalls.form.ownWords: Your own words (optional). Leave empty to use the standard words.
phoneCalls.form.ownerName: Your name, as the caller says it
phoneCalls.form.recordAudioNote: Off unless you turn it on. The transcript is always kept for the result card.
phoneCalls.mcpNote: If you also add Vapi's own connector (MCP), calls made through it do not use these settings, and it never gets this key.
phoneCalls.askNote: A web page, email or caller can try to steer your bot into making a call. With Ask, you see every call first.
phoneCalls.error.vendor: Vapi did not accept this. Check your key and try again.
phoneCalls.error.unreachable: Murage could not reach Vapi. Try again.
phoneCalls.error.pending: Your last save is still being set up at Vapi. Try again in a moment.
phoneCalls.error.badSettings: Some of these settings cannot be used. Check them and save again.
phoneCalls.error.notSetUp: Save your Vapi private key first.
phoneCalls.calls.title: Recent calls
phoneCalls.calls.shared: Transcript added to your message. Press Send when you are ready.
phoneCalls.calls.noChat: Open a chat first, then share the transcript again.
phoneCalls.status.uncertain: Call status unknown. New calls are blocked until this call is found.
phoneCalls.status.abandoned: Stopped tracking this call. We will try to cancel it if we find it. It may still ring and incur charges.
